stem: A client taking amlodipine asks which adverse effect is most characteristic and dose related. Which response is best?
rationale: Current amlodipine labeling identifies edema as the most common adverse reaction and shows that its frequency is dose related. The other listed effects are not characteristic dose-related adverse reactions of amlodipine.
educational_objective: Identify peripheral edema as the characteristic dose-related adverse reaction of amlodipine.
source_organization: DailyMed / U.S. National Library of Medicine
source_locator: Section 6.1 Clinical Trials Experience: edema is the most common adverse reaction and is dose related
source_claim_supported: Edema is the most common amlodipine adverse reaction and its incidence is dose related.
blueprint_source_organization: National Council of State Boards of Nursing (NCSBN)
blueprint_locator: Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies, printed p.12/PDF p.16
blueprint_topic: Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies — medication adverse effects
correction_summary: Removed an unsupported arteriolar/capillary mechanism and unsafe implication that edema excludes heart failure; narrowed the item to the directly labeled dose-related adverse effect.
